segments.title: Bridge Collapse & Eel Medical Case
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens with bridge collapse news (Baltimore Key Bridge), acknowledges missing prior coverage, then pivots to 12-inch eel surgically removed from Vietnamese man's rectum.

segments.title: Hype Train Level 10 Marathon
segments.notes: Sub/bits surge summons Hype Train for extended freestyle rap session; reaches level 10, discusses immortality, father issues, and smokes two packs of 'train crack' while chat sustains it.

segments.title: Jeff Ripple Delivers Eel Story
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple finally reads the eel medical case after Hype Train derailment: 43-year-old Vietnamese man, 12-inch eel removed alive from abdomen, peritonitis, successful surgery.

segments.title: Chet's Science Debut: Iodine Clock & Wing Protocol
segments.notes: Chet unveils new studio, introduces ChetAI (reprogrammed from AI Rooney), demonstrates iodine clock reaction from Discord submission, watches humanoid robot dance video, executes plastic-wrap face wing-eating stunt with Chendall assisting.

segments.title: Closeout & Raid
segments.notes: Case thanks chat, notes ranch was available for wings, acknowledges Kendelle sent Chendall, sends raid to Daint Sauce.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Brief cold-open exchange; dismissed science, endorsed cheese.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: science correspondent. Debuted new dedicated studio, introduced ChetAI co-host, ran iodine clock reaction and robot video, executed plastic-wrap wing-eating stunt.

characters.name: ChetAI
characters.notes: AI co-host. Debuted as Chet's neural co-host (reprogrammed from AI Rooney), bantered on robot apocalypse and wing safety.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Delivered eel medical story after Hype Train interruption; thanked sub donors.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: musical interruption. Commandeered broadcast for 36 minutes at level 10; freestyled on immortality, father trauma, and 'train crack'.

characters.name: Chendall
characters.notes: lab assistant. Kendelle's friend; reluctantly assisted Chet with plastic-wrap wing stunt and heimlich demonstration.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Sent Chendall to assist Chet; mentioned off-camera.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Received dedicated theme via sub goal; mentioned off-camera.

lore_notes.fact: Now has a dedicated permanent studio room for Chet Guy the Science Eyes, built by Case due to chat demand.
Created by reprogramming an AI Rooney model with Chet's brain; Chet holds LLCs for the IP preventing rename.
Reached level 10; Case acknowledged need to update visual enclosure due to time spent together.
Received custom theme music after chat sub goal completed.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell opened with a belated bridge collapse report and a 12-inch eel medical case, but a massive sub surge summoned Hype Train for a 36-minute level-10 freestyle marathon. Jeff Ripple eventually delivered the eel story, then Chet debuted his new science studio with ChetAI, demonstrated an iodine clock reaction, reviewed humanoid robots, and executed a plastic-wrap face wing-eating stunt assisted by Kendelle's friend Chendall before raiding Daint Sauce.
